entities.description: A vertical, silver-colored metal flagpole topped with a gold-colored spherical finial stands against a pale blue sky, with a blurred blue and white flag attached to its side.

A close-up, low-angle shot of a weathered stone statue of a male figure with curly hair, looking upward and to the right with a solemn expression. The figure wears a draped toga or cloak with a clasp on the shoulder, and the stone surface shows significant aging with dark patches and texture. In the blurred background to the right, a flag with blue, white, and red vertical stripes is visible against a clear sky.

subject.clothing: draped toga or cloak with shoulder clasp

background.flag: blue, white, red vertical stripes, blurred
